subject: POC provisioning milestone trajectory — API key handoff & peering windows
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Ahmed <sana@zephyrhealth.com>, Nate Lewis <nate@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC provisioning milestone trajectory — API key handoff & peering windows

Hi Sana / Nate,

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our MAP conversation I put together an initial milestone trajectory focused on the environment setup tasks we discussed: org seed, API key provisioning, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. Attached is a lightweight MAP_trajectory_v1.xlsx that lays out owners, target windows, and one-touch acceptance criteria.

High level asks for this sprint: 
- Confirm the VPC peering window that works for your infra team (we have open 6/5 - 6/9 or 6/12 - 6/16).
- Confirm the single service account you want us to seed in your org for ephemeral API keys.
- Provide a CIDR block for the peering route (or confirm we use the sample in peering_template.txt).

Quick notes on timing: we can seed the org and provision ephemeral API keys within 24 hours of receiving the service account email address and IAM role details. Peering requires coordination with your VPC team — estimated lead time is 2-5 business days depending on approvals.

I attached the peering_template.txt to speed your infra team's review. If you prefer, we can run the peering configuration in a dry-run on a staging VPC first.

Next steps: please reply with preferred peering window + service account name and I’ll schedule a short 30-min technical cutover for the window you pick.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.ch@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: MAP_trajectory_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
Attachment: peering_template.txt (text, 4KB)

From: Sana Ahmed <sana@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, ops@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC provisioning milestone trajectory — API key handoff & peering windows

Irene — thanks for the write up and the files. Quick answers from our side: 
- Preferred peering window: 6/12 - 6/16 (we want the earlier window to align with our release but need the 12th so infra can validate).
- Service account: zephyr-poc-service@zephyrhealth.com (we'll create the IAM role with the minimal network and EC2 describe permissions).
- CIDR: use 10.50.0.0/16 for the peer route; we’ll reserve 10.51.0.0/16 for staging.

Two questions:
1) Do you support a temporary allowlist change (we want to open 443 for your GW IPs for the peering test only during the 6/12 window)?
2) If we run the peering on staging first, do you accept the same MAP acceptance criteria or do you require separate signoff?

On the staging note — we prefer a dry-run. If you can confirm the staging cadence we’ll sign off quickly. Also looping ops@zephyrhealth.com for infra scheduling.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Ahmed
Senior Product Ops, Zephyr Health
sana@zephyrhealth.com

Thanks Sana — great timing. Quick operational notes from our side: 
- We can do a temporary allowlist change for the 6/12 window. We'll open the ports to the two egress IPs listed in the attachment and then remove them immediately after verification. Please confirm the public egress IP you expect for your infra actions.
- For staging dry-run: we treat it as a MAP gating checkpoint. If staging passes with the acceptance criteria in MAP_trajectory_v1.xlsx, we don’t require a separate full signoff — we will auto-promote the results to production readiness checklist.
- API keys: once you send the service account email, we will provision ephemeral API keys scoped to the seeding role and post them to your secure artifacts folder (link in HubSpot card). Keys will have a 30-day TTL by default; we can shorten if you want.

HubSpot link for the record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (MAP and tickets live there).

Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: POC provisioning milestone trajectory — API key handoff & peering windows

Sana — appreciate the quick confirmation. I booked the 6/12 02:00-04:00 PT peering window with our infra team and created a short ops runbook for the cutover. Steps include: 
1) Confirm service account IAM role (zephyr-poc-service@zephyrhealth.com) — we will not seed keys until role passes our sanity checks.
2) Apply temporary allowlist (two egress IPs) for 6/12 01:30 PT.
3) Execute peering and run synthetic traffic tests (15 min).
4) Validate API key exchange via secure artifact and run sample inference calls (10 min).
5) Rollback allowlist post-verify at 6/12 04:15 PT.

I also prepared a DocuSign powerform for the MAP acceptance signature so we can close the first milestone once staging dry-run is green: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&acct=1111&formId=abcd1234

If that all looks good I’ll add the action items to the HubSpot MAP card and mark owners.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
